verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own docs describe CI/CD experiments for catching quality regressions before they ship, offered explicitly as the way to block deploys. They also document a GitHub Actions workflow using the first-party langfuse/experiment-action, with run_experiment and evaluators providing the eval logic. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how pass/fail thresholds are set to fail a build, CI support beyond GitHub Actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI gating.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Use Langfuse experiments in your CI/CD pipeline to catch quality regressions before they ship.
Create a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the script with langfuse/experiment-action.
